Some weeks ago Dame Rumour (always a liar as we well know!) reported that our one-time Cross-country champion ARTHUR CLARK was dead; but later we learned that he is wintering in Malaga in Spain enjoying the sun and golf, and will be returning to his Broadstairs home in March!
